artifact_audit.artifact: Ring-controlled merchants lacked ordinary customer history, making low causal merchant degree an unrealistically strong proxy for fraud.
artifact_audit.fix: Reallocated 4% of the existing payment budget to ordinary customers at ring merchants, mostly before attack activation; total transaction count is unchanged.

exposure.definition: At-risk value counted once per original payment; abusive refund value replaces, rather than adds to, the purchase value.

methodology.features: causal event-time features computed without labels
methodology.generalization: all events touching held-ring entities removed before train/validation feature extraction; test contains ordinary benign traffic plus only the held archetype
methodology.split: cross-seed train/validation/test; no seed appears in two roles per fold
methodology.threshold: selected for maximum F1 on validation seed only

threshold_policy.ml: maximum F1 on a separate validation seed over thresholds 0.05..0.95
